;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Afghan authorities say that, in a joint ground and air operation on Saturday night, [[Afghan Armed Forces|Afghan]] and foreign forces killed the head of [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant – Khorasan Province|ISIL/K]], along with ten other members of the militant group. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack/head-of-islamic-state-in-afghanistan-killed-says-government-idUSKCN1LB0BD (Reuters)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/08/26/world/isis-leader-afghanistan-strike/index.html (CNN)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Pope Francis's visit to Ireland]]
**[[Pope Francis]] holds Sunday Mass at [[Phoenix Park]] in [[Dublin]], [[Ireland]], for the [[World Meeting of Families]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/08/26/europe/pope-francis-ireland-sunday-mass-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**Archbishop [[Carlo Maria Viganò]] accuses Pope Francis of covering up sexual abuse allegations against [[Theodore McCarrick]]. Pope Francis declines to comment on Viganò's accusations. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/pope-francis-declines-comment-allegations-sexual-abuse-cover/story?id=57418879 (ABC News)]
**After returning from his visit, the [[Pope]] says that, when parents discover their child is [[homosexuality|homosexual]], they should not judge or condemn them. However, he also remarks that "many things can be done by [[psychiatry]]". [https://www.hln.be/nieuws/buitenland/paus-raadt-psychiatrie-aan-wanneer-homoseksualiteit-tijdens-kindertijd-aan-het-licht-komt~afe68e23/ (Belga via ''Het Laatste Nieuws'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/the-latest-pope-denounces-irelands-forced-adoptions/2018/08/26/dd87b6a0-a919-11e8-9a7d-cd30504ff902_story.html?utm_term=.b390e4df5d1e (''The Washington Post'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Kerala floods]]
**The death toll from the [[Kerala]] floods rise to 445, while 15 remain missing. [https://www.gulfnews.com/news/asia/india/kerala-floods-death-toll-rises-to-445 (''Gulf News'')]
*A magnitude 6.0 earthquake strikes the western [[Iran]]ian province of [[Kermanshah]], killing at least two people and injuring more than 200 others. [https://www.dw.com/en/iran-earthquake-injures-hundreds-fatalities-reported/a-45230105 (Deutsche Welle)]
*Eight people die in a house fire in [[Chicago]], [[Illinois]]. [http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/local/breaking/ct-met-seven-killed-20180826-story.html (''Chicago Tribune'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Jacksonville Landing shooting]]
**The sheriff's office reports a mass shooting at a [[Madden NFL 19|Madden 19]] tournament at the [[Jacksonville Landing]] shopping mall in [[Jacksonville, Florida]]. Two attendees are killed, and nine others are taken to nearby hospitals. The suspected shooter is reported dead at the scene. [https://www.twincities.com/2018/08/26/florida-authorities-report-mass-shooting-at-riverfront-mall-in-jacksonville/ (''Twin Cities Pioneer Press'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45315970 (BBC)]
*[[2018 Chemnitz stabbing attack]]
**One man is killed, two more are seriously injured and partly violent protests erupt after a stabbing attack in [[Chemnitz]], Germany. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-stabbing-leads-to-far-right-protest-in-chemnitz/a-45238738 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Politics and election
*[[2018 Zimbabwean general election]]
**[[Emmerson Mnangagwa]] is sworn in as the [[President of Zimbabwe]], after an [[2018 Bulawayo bombing|assassination attempt]] two months earlier. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/08/zimbabwe-emmerson-mnangagwa-sworn-president-180826100106919.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2018 Colombian anti-corruption referendum]]
**[[Colombia]] holds its first referendum since [[Colombian Constitution of 1991|amending its constitution in 1991]] and fails to pass anti-[[corruption]] measures due to low voter turnout. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/colombians-vote-on-anti-corruption-referendum/2018/08/26/4a19bf64-a8e5-11e8-ad6f-080770dcddc2_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] 
*Iran's finance minister [[Masoud Karbasian]] is sacked after an impeachment attempt by [[Parliament of Iran|parliament]]. This is the second impeachment this month, after [[Ali Rabiei]]'s on 8 August. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/08/26/irans-parliament-impeaches-economy-minister-latest-blow-embattled/ (''Telegraph'')]
